name: Single filer at high income in Neuchâtel (2026)
description: Single person earning CHF 200,000 in Neuchâtel, one of the highest-tax cantons

sources.description: Verified using Swiss tax calculation engine with progressive cantonal brackets. Federal tax calculated using official 2026 Bundessteuer tariff. Neuchâtel cantonal/municipal tax uses progressive marginal rates: 12% up to CHF 50k, 17% from CHF 50k-150k, 20% above CHF 150k = (50000×12% + 100000×17% + 50000×20%) = CHF 33,000. Social security uses ALV at 1.1% capped at CHF 148,200; no contribution applies above the cap (ALV solidarity contribution abolished by law effective 1 January 2023, AVIG Art. 90a). Neuchâtel has among Switzerland's highest tax rates.

Social security rates verified against official BSV documentation. ALV: 1.1% employee contribution up to CHF 148,200 cap. The former solidarity contribution above the cap automatically expired by law on 1 January 2023 per AVIG Art. 90a and has not been reinstated for 2024-2026.
